rules: Do not copy mock user messages, fixed AI replies, fake saved data, fake durations or simulated Help content.
Use actual bundled catalog content and current native AI responses. Activity titles and core meanings remain unchanged.
Retain native connecting/capture-starting/music-return/failure distinctions even where the Lab did not render every state.
A local save success and an AI follow-up success are separate; do not report that saving failed when only the follow-up failed.
Preserve current native support, excerpt approval, feedback and deletion actions; wording must match what each action does.
